== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary replaces the final sentence with the plural hit-target wording. The 2002 Supplement reaffirms it. The 2013 slip’s subtype header drops the D in Used. The actual faces and the 2017 slip establish the unchanged Used Interrupt subtype.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=26|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 26. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=9|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 9. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=105|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 105. Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf#page=2|Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 2. [[:File:CC-D-blasteddroid.gif|Complete replacement face]].
